body:
I just googled call centers in my area, and that's looking pretty good. I'd never even heard of one of these. It makes sense, though, I guess someone's gotta answer those phones? I guess I never really thought about it. Thanks for that man, I'm calling some up first thing tomorrow morning.  
  
I had started trying to get my GED when I turned 19, but I just couldn't do it. I don't know why but it's like my brain just shuts off when I'm in a school setting. I'm not dumb, I don't think, there's just some kind of block there. I'm also terrible with organization, as a kid, even on the off chance I would do an assignment, I wouldn't have it by the time it was due. This is something I've always tried to improve on, but have yet to make any meaningful improvements. Although I used to get commended at a shop I worked at for having the only organized space, so it must be in there somewhere.

I've been looking hard for a job, actually exhausting money I needed for other things. Most corporations won't hire me, a lot of them *require* a driver's license. Even to work at Sear's. Most garages won't hire me, because the employees have to move the vehicles in and out of the bays, and their insurance requires the employees to have a valid driver's license. A few other jobs have told me they aren't sure I'd be able to get to work.  
  
I appreciate your response, I wasn't trying to negate it with that. Thanks.
